title: Also export the report as PDF
desc: Users will want PDF; add a PDF exporter beside the CSV one.

title: CSV header row is never specified
desc: The plan says CSV but never names the columns of the header row, so two implementers would write two different files. The Output section is the only place the format is named, and it lists no column, no order and no quoting rule; name them there so the export is checkable.
